newsitem.title: USA: Westell to offer high-speed access system.
newsitem.headline: Westell to offer high-speed access system.

text.p: Westell Technologies Inc said Tuesday it is introducing an Internet and remote network access system that operates at speeds 75 times faster than standard 28.8 kilobits per second (kbps) computer modems.

The company said its FlexCap2 Rate Adaptive ADSL system provides downstream speeds of 640 kbps to 2.2 megabits per second (mbps) and upstream rates of between 272 kbps and 1.088 mbps. The system also provides high-speed remote access to local-area computer networks.
Westell develops digital subscriber line systems.
Its shares closed up 1/16 Tuesday at 14-9/16.
